audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer read Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Twisted Fate, Twisted Fate, Galio. The page gave two answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly. The shape is right: Galio owns 2-5 because Pick a Card only reaches 200 units and Twisted Fate has no dash, then Destiny at 6 takes the game off the lane, and Hero's Entrance at 5500 range answers the Gate picks late.
audit.corrected: All disagreeing phases[N].side moved to the content-layer verdict with ratings and whys rewritten in the same group. content win[N] already matches on disk, so no content chart edit is included.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 and first-item rows were written as Galio spikes ('the map owes you taxes', 'your MR makes AP trades a subscription') when both belong to Twisted Fate.
audit.why: Destiny is 170/140/110 with 5500 range and a 1.5-second Gate — it converts his first item into map-wide kill pressure Galio cannot match while the lane is still even.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and phases[5] now describe Destiny's reveal-and-Gate and the roam threat it funds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to wait for Pick a Card's cooldown as the green light. Pick a Card is a flat 6 seconds at every rank — there is no cooldown window to wait for, and the actual tell is the auto-attack reset on the wind-up.
audit.why: enemyKit W: cd '6', range 200, flags autoReset and hardCC. missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell for this exact pair. Advice built on a cooldown that never goes away is advice that gets a player stunned.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, report[9].t and phases[3].why now key off the card cycle, the 200-unit range and the auto-attack reset instead of a cooldown timer.

audit.why: It is the field that carries the numbers.
audit.corrected: Now states Pick a Card flat 6s at 200 range, Wild Cards 6s, Destiny 170s at rank 1 with a 1.5s Gate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Justice Punch a stun and, in `early`, calls Colossal Smash a stun ('Justice Punch dash into Colossal Smash stun'). Justice Punch is a knock-up and Colossal Smash is an empowered auto-attack with no CC at all.
audit.why: ownerKit: E knocks up the first champion hit; P is a bonus-magic-damage area auto. Galio's only stun-class CC is the Shield of Durand taunt.
audit.corrected: whys[1], spikes[0].text and `early` corrected. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d bleed also fixed (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are close since Twisted Fate's Wild Cards poke trades evenly with your own wave clear, but from level 3 onward your Justice Punch dash into Colossal Smash stun punishes his card-throw animations and forces all-ins he can't easily escape. Keep shoving so he can't free-farm long-range Blue Cards, and hold Shield of Durand for when he tries to red-card you point blank. You want lane priority before 6 so his Destiny doesn't teleport back into a losing lane with gold advantage.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are close since Twisted Fate's Wild Cards poke trades evenly with your own wave clear, but from level 3 onward your Justice Punch dash into the Shield of Durand taunt punishes his card-throw animation and forces all-ins he can't escape without a dash. Keep shoving so he can't free-farm long-range Blue Cards, and hold Shield of Durand for when he steps to 200 range for a card. You want lane priority before 6 so his Destiny doesn't teleport back into a losing lane with gold advantage.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Save Shield of Durand', 'Gold Card' and 'Use Hero's Entrance' — all three are FALSE POSITIVES (Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance are Galio's real abilities; Gold Card is the real card name and is used correctly under the AbilityName (Effect) convention). Chart: the full layer said 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer matched packet.levelChart, so I moved the full layer onto it — no win[N] edits needed because content was already correct on disk. phases[0] side stays 'Skill' (both layers already agree) and phases[6].rating stays 6/10. The biggest substantive fix is that all the 'wait for Pick a Card's cooldown' advice was unusable: the ability is a flat 6s at every rank.
